description: This file implements the SharedStorageImplementation class, which manages shared storage operations, including registration, configuration, value setting/getting, deletion, and event dispatching within a plugin framework. It interacts with various storage interfaces and handles notifications and synchronization.

classes.name: SharedStorageImplementation
classes.description: A class that manages shared storage operations, including registration, configuration, value management, and event dispatching within a plugin framework.
